high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a YouTube video page. The main content of the video is displayed at the top, showing a person lying on the ground, firing a machine gun with a suppressor attached. The suppressor is visibly melting due to the heat generated by the continuous firing of 700 rounds. The video is titled "700 Continuous Rounds Melts Suppressor" and has garnered 63 million views since it was uploaded three years ago. The video is hosted by Caters Clips, which has 2.28 million subscribers. The channel's logo is visible in the bottom left corner of the video thumbnail
